And then there's Lilith. Some of you have heard that Adam had a first wife named Lilith, who refused to submit to him and turned into a demon. You heard it in a sermon, a video, a post somebody shared.

Here's the tea. Lilith is not in Genesis. Not one time. The full Lilith story comes from Jewish folklore, mostly a writing called the Alphabet of Ben Sira, written well over a thousand years after Genesis. The word only shows up once in the Hebrew Bible, in Isaiah thirty-four, and the King James translators called it a screech owl.
